Episode 256. Morganiel (5)
“You think you know?”
“Ooh, is it something good?”
Luna and Murakan shouted at the same time.
“I can't say I've figured everything out. But I can feel one thing for sure. If I step into this place, I will be able to wield this energy.”
“The black energy that forms this space?”
“...Yes, sister.”
The moment he touched the entrance, Jin was realizing that fact.
Not shadow energy, but a black energy.
That power could not yet be named. As far as Jin and the Genesis Knights knew, this black energy had never once appeared in the world until now.

“If so, it is highly likely that it is an authority that Solderet prepared for Jin. Brother Jin, what is your feeling about that power? We still cannot feel anything from the black energy that makes up this space. It is just darkness.”
“It is not aura energy, nor is it shadow energy. It seems to be... a power of a higher dimension than that, Brother Battle God.”
The Genesis Knights' eyes widened. Murakan, in particular, was so shocked that his jaw dropped.
Shadow energy.

The status of that power, which symbolized Solderet, was always the highest. Not only aura and magic, but also the lightning of the Plutonians or any authority wielded by the highest-tier gods were bound to fall short when compared in pure status to shadow energy.
It wasn't that the authority used by the egos of the Sun God didn't have points where it was superior to spiritual energy, but even that could not be described as clearly ahead.
Only the power of a perfectly resurrected 'Kinzelo' could be said to be of a higher caliber than spiritual energy. At least, that is how everyone who knew spiritual energy well had perceived it.
But a power superior to that; he could not grasp the reality of it at all.
“The youngest wouldn't be spouting nonsense... so for now, this is good news. If you obtain that power, you will become stronger, right?”
Will I become stronger?
At Luna's extremely simple question, for some reason, Jin could not readily answer.
'...Stronger. This power does not fit... such a human standard.'
A god.
Not the beings who were commonly called gods but were, in truth, just immortals born from the energy of the Sun God after his death, but something so transcendent that it could only be called a god.
The darkness that Jin was feeling now was that kind of power.
To the point where he felt the fear of whether it was alright for a human to grasp such an authority. It felt as if he would no longer be able to be human if he were to embrace this darkness.
His hand was trembling.
More than the overwhelming enemies, Kelliark and Malugia, he suddenly felt more afraid of himself. However, even in the midst of his terror, he could intuit one thing.
'If I grasp this power, I might be able to win. Against them. It is certain that I can face them much more easily than now.'
Therefore, it was not a matter of choice.
He had to accept it. If he just gave up on being human, the war, which he could only rely on a vague hope for, would become a winnable fight.
'What... do I become?'
Everything he had built up until now as a human, as a warrior, as Jin.
Power, authority, honor.
And people, the people he cherished and loved.

It felt as if all of that would be swept away by this darkness in a single breath and disappear somewhere. To a domain that the human Jin Runcandel could never know, to a somewhere that the human Jin Runcandel could never love.
“Jin.”
“Ah...! Father?”
Chiron's firm hand gently shook Jin's shoulder. Without realizing it, Jin was panting for breath, his entire body drenched in a cold sweat.
“You are afraid.”
“...I have shown a shameful side of myself.”
“What is it that you are so afraid of.”
“I... don't know well.”

“Jin, I do not know exactly what you have just seen. But in any case, in the end, the end for all of us is one of two things. To win, or to lose. To struggle, or to stop. To die, or to live. Whatever you become, this fact does not change.”
Jin's breathing was still ragged.

“If we put our minds to it, we can kill hundreds of thousands, no, millions of people with a single sword strike. The fear that those who can be so meaninglessly swept away at any time feel will not be smaller than what you are feeling now. However, you must not tremble in fear like them. Do you know the reason why?”
Jin did not answer and met Chiron's eyes. Although he spoke as if he were scolding him, Chiron was smirking.
“There is no special reason. It is simply because I do not wish to see it.”
“Pardon?”

“You are my son, and I have never given you love. Perhaps that is why, seeing you tremble now, an uncomfortable feeling is welling up inside me. It is probably a common emotion like guilt, a sense of responsibility, things I have long forgotten. This father has just now finished off Morganiel and fulfilled his destiny. Do not ruin my mood. Must I writhe in guilt?”
It was absurd logic. Jin felt as if his head had been hit by a hammer about ten times and blinked his eyes.
“You are quite shameless, Father.”

At those words, Luna was startled and looked back and forth between Jin and Chiron. Although it was just a joke, for any of the siblings to talk to Chiron in this way was something she had never imagined. The same went for Chiron making such a joke.
'It's not entirely a joke either, I suppose. Father has been feeling sorry to us ever since he overcame his demonic transformation.'
Soon, Luna also looked at Chiron and opened her mouth.
“The youngest is right, Father. Why don't you just go ahead and writhe in guilt.”
“Where does a flagbearer dare to interfere when the Patriarch and the Young Patriarch are talking.”
“In any case, youngest, you have no choice but to accept my shameless demand.”
“And why is that?”
“Because you are the Young Patriarch and I am the Patriarch. Follow the order.”
The three of them Chiron, Jin, and Luna burst into laughter at the same time.
Before he knew it, Jin's breathing had returned to a calm state, and his shaking eyes had also become composed.

“I feel a bit better, Father. In any case, if I receive this power and something goes wrong or I become strange, the people here will take care of the aftermath, yet I was making a fuss. Let's return for now. I felt it when I had my hand on the door, but it seems that both the first patriarch's body and Barisada are needed to enter. We will have to wait for Lady Ameris to undo the curse.”
“It is a strange thing. Lord Solderet is said to have chosen you a thousand years ago, yet why did he make it so that those two things are necessary.”
“Now that you mention it, it is strange.”
“If Lord Solderet is inside, be sure to ask him.”
“Yes, Father. If we can enter together, let's go together.”
“That would be fine too.”
Chiron, Jin, Luna. They looked more comfortable with each other than ever before. Murakan and Van exchanged glances and shrugged.
“Tsk, what a pity. Chiron, because of you, I missed my chance for revenge.”
“What do you mean by that, Murakan?”

“I've also had a few times where I suddenly lost my mind like the kid just now. It was mostly because of memories from a thousand years ago. Every time, the kid would whack me on the back of the head, telling me to get a grip. So I thought, this time, it's finally my turn. I would have given him a good, stinging smack.”
“If you're disappointed, don't miss the next chance.”
“Where does a mere patriarch dare to use informal speech with a guardian dragon.”
“You told me to.”

Not long after, the Genesis Knights were able to go outside the black line again. The domain of Morganiel was still shining a bright yellow, and the flying fortress Lafrarosa was still there in the sky.
It had taken them three hours to walk cautiously on the way in, but on the way back, they increased their speed. The Genesis Knights returned to the main force in an instant.
[Oh my, you have returned, my lord!]

Ozdok ran out and bowed his head deeply to the Genesis Knights. He had been outside the battlefield while Morganiel and the expeditionary force were engaged in their chase, and had been discovered by the Golden Fleet on guard and had come here.
[My lord, it is the lifelong regret of this Ozdok that I could not witness in person the great moment when you executed all five kings of the Black Sea. Congratulations, my lord!]
Unlike usual when he was flattering, Ozdok was actually shedding tears of emotion. Naturally, for him too, the Black Sea expedition had been the most overwhelmingly difficult experience of his life.
“You too have worked hard in the meantime, Ozdok.”

[Hehe, what hardship have I endured. It is all thanks to you, my lord, that a lowly creature like me has been able to live a worthy life... Young Master! (At this point, Ozdok grabbed Jin's hand) It is also thanks to you, Young Master! It has been a long time since I have greeted you, Young Master!]
“I heard from sister Luna what a great role you played in the expedition. If there is anything you want, say it. I will grant it.”
In reality, Ozdok had played a very crucial role in the Black Sea expedition. If it weren't for him, Chiron would have needed a much more painful time to overcome his demonic transformation.

[I-is that really true!? In that case, my inner core that you took last time...! Of course, it's not that I have any other intentions, it's just that I feel empty. Sniff, sniff. Wait, I smell my inner core from here... Young Master? Don't tell me you melted my inner core into your sword?]
“Ahem, sorry. If you say something else...”
Ozdok sniffled for a moment, then nodded his head.
[It's alright... I am a body that will become a butler of Runcandel from now on anyway, so there is no problem in living without an inner core, good heavens! W-what is that!?]
Suddenly, Ozdok let out a sigh and pointed a finger at the sky.
'...A dimensional gate!?'
The dimensional gate that had opened in the sky out of nowhere had a similar form to the one they had seen in the battle at the Empire.
A form where the Milky Way was flowing beyond the gate, just like Malugia's eyes. However, what emerged from within was not her.
It was the fleet of the Demon Army.
